pack.logline: England star Kildunne dropped for Canada rematch. One quiet moment that captures why it matters.
pack.scene: England star Kildunne dropped for Canada rematch. Ellie Kildunne has been dropped to the bench in the England Red Roses squad to face Canada on Friday, a week on from suffering defeat in Toronto which ended a 41-match unbeaten run.. The scene opens on a figure mid-thought.
pack.beat: The figure turns toward the light as the moment settles - a decision made.
